messages:
marta_finance: Heads-up: noticed GCP marketplace Jun invoice missing consumption rows for reseller partner 'res-710'. Missing usage ~ $14,950. Raw export seems to include the rows but they're not linked to reseller id during assembly. Anyone seen this?

kevin_billing: Pulling blob now. Could be new field or changed order. Sample raw CSV excerpt: 
```
invoice,usage_id,partner_id,amount,reseller_label,reseller_id
inv-20260630,usr-3345,partner-710,14950,reseller:zone-7,
```

marta_finance: Reseller_id empty in raw file. But our previous months had reseller_id populated.

gcp-marketplace-bot: GCP Marketplace notice: "reseller_id column may be empty for consolidated reseller exports during billing window overlap" (automated). See https://gcp.example/marketplace/announcements (bot).

owen_revops: If reseller_id is empty we should fallback using reseller_label -> partner mapping. Do we maintain that map in billing service?

kevin_billing: We have a mapping table but billing job expects reseller_id to be present. I'll add fallback join on reseller_label and partner_id. Creating ticket BILL-6023.

rachel_partners: PartnersOps: This will affect payouts. Recommend issuing manual credit if reassembly won't complete before payroll. Also want partner notification draft.

marta_finance: Estimated delta $14,950. Owen, can you approve manual credit up to $15k while we attempt reingest?

own_revops: Approve manual credit up to $15k for res-710. Please document approval in finance-approvals.

kevin_billing: PR opened to add reseller_label fallback. Scheduling reassembly 2026-09-02 02:00 UTC. If reassembly succeeds we'll void manual credit. If not, proceed with credit memo.

gcp-marketplace-bot: Advisory: "During SKU consolidation windows, reseller identifiers may shift; ensure fallback mapping is used" (automated).
file_notes: Created for marketplace/reseller billing incident: GCP missing reseller_id leading to unlinked consumption rows. Includes approval for manual credit and reassembly plan.
